Before you decide

What if I'm not a candidate?

Start with the text visit. If Dr. Al-Deek reviews your intake and decides treatment isn't right for you, your $29 comes back — and she'll explain why, by text.

What will medication cost me?

Medication runs $129–$299 a month. You'll confirm your exact price by text before anything is ever charged — no surprise charges.

Is this private?

Yes. Care happens by private text message — no video, no waiting room, nobody sees you. Your intake is handled as a secure, HIPAA-compliant medical record.

This quiz is educational and is not a diagnosis or medical advice. It doesn't make you a patient. Treatment, including any prescription, is only provided after a clinician reviews your full medical intake and decides it's appropriate for you.
